repo_notes.content: heartflow 是 Rust 实现的终端 AI agent,二进制/命令名是 hf(不是 heartflow)。Cargo workspace 成员在 crates/*,依赖单向:cli -> {provider, runtime, api, tools, mcp, store, commands},provider -> {api, runtime}。请以此命名与拓扑为准组织各页。
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: 运行时核心在 crates/runtime:conversation.rs 区分磁盘转录与喂给模型的注入视图(build_replay_messages);prompt.rs 组装系统提示词(Memory/Rules/Skills/Project,含 memory 分层夹紧与 redact_secrets);compact.rs 定义 CompactionConfig。crates/store 是派生自 JSON 的 SQLite FTS5 缓存,JSON 始终权威。
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: 发布流水线零 Node:scripts/release.sh + git-cliff 驱动版本/GitHub Release/crates.io,bucket/ 目录兼作 scoop bucket。面向用户的文档站在 docs/src(mdBook)。
repo_notes.author: maintainer

pages.title: Overview

pages.title: Installation & Distribution

pages.title: CLI Reference

pages.title: REPL & Slash Commands

pages.title: Sessions & History Store

pages.title: MCP Client
